name: Emerald of Growth
body:
Price 30,000 gp; Slot none; CL 11th; Weight 1/2 lb.; Aura faint transmutation, moderate conjuration

DESCRIPTION

An emerald of growth is a perfect gem, as big as a human fist, favored by elves and druids, who use it to mend the ravages of men and monsters upon nature. When someone looks through the gem, all plants within the watched area grow at double rate for 24 hours. Plant creatures seen through the emerald of growth gain the Advanced simple template for the same period. This includes creatures temporarily transformed into plants by magic. Alternatively, the emerald can be shattered to summon a single treant, as summon nature’s ally VI. The treant is under the control of the creature that broke the gem and doesn’t possess the animate trees ability.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 15,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells plant growth, summon nature’s ally VI
